decisions.context: How to read 'a reader never excuses a torn or tampered log as another writer's append' (D65; R43, P15). A writer adds its entry and then records it as complete. Anything wrong at or before the recorded entries is reported whoever holds the case. A lock held by the reader's own thread through another handle or path, or a lock error, does not count as another writer (D50, verify-34). Readers wait for the lock before reporting, so a stuck writer stalls every window
decisions.answer: Only another writer holding the case excuses, and only after the recorded entries (design default; what T12 builds)

decisions.context: R42 (revision 13, D124) says that under lock-file interference, a log that reads intact holds every save whose writer was told it was recorded.
